vehicleCount.description: Sum of count of all vehicle types detected in the past 5 minutes within the zone of junction lane corresponding to this observation.

junctionMode.description: Represents the current operational mode of the traffic junction corresponding to this observation. It takes up values like 'FLSH' (Flash), 'ATFXFXNO' (Fixed Time Fixed CT), 'ATFXFXVA' (Fixed Time + 'VA'), 'ATATFXNO' 'ATFLO (Fixed CT)', 'LOFF' (Lamps Off), 'MOPR' (Manual Operation), 'ARED' (All Red)  etc.

Vehicle detector cameras which work on image processing techniques are used to capture the count. Vehicle detectors detect vehicle counts from the virtual zones created in the field of view of each camera.

vehicleCount.description: Sum of count of all vehicle types detected in the past 5 minutes within the zone of junction lane corresponding to this observation.

roadOccupancy.description: Percentage of the junction lane occupied by vehicles, in the last 5 minutes, corresponding to this observation. The value is to be multiplied by 100 to get the percentage. The distance of the junction lane can be retrieved from the static dataset.

junctionMode.description: Represents the current operational mode of the traffic junction corresponding to this observation. It takes up values like 'FLSH' (Flash), 'ATFXFXNO' (Fixed Time Fixed CT), 'ATFXFXVA' (Fixed Time + 'VA'), 'ATATFXNO' 'ATFLO (Fixed CT)', 'LOFF' (Lamps Off), 'MOPR' (Manual Operation), 'ARED' (All Red)  etc.

pcu.description: The value of this field represents the sum of PCU of all vehicle types detected by the camera at the time instance corresponding to this observation. A Passenger Car Unit (PCU) is a numeric value assigned to a vehicle based on its size. A PCU value of 1 is assigned to the basic 4-wheeler passenger car, which is considered as a reference value. Based on this reference, all other vehicle types are assigned PCU values accordingly. The PCU values calculated from the site analysis assignment based on vehicle types is as follows - 3.5 for any of ['Large Truck', 'Bus'], 1 for any of ['Mini Carriage', 'MPV', 'Saloon Car', 'Micro Truck', 'Mid Passenger Car', 'SUV', 'Pickup', 'Passenger Car'], 0.5 for any of ['MotorCycle', 'Unknown'], 2.2 for ['Mid Truck'].

documents.label: Realtime Locations of Public Transit Buses in Kalyan-Dombivli City
documents.description: Realtime bus position information and arrival timings along with trip schedules of public transit buses from Kalyan-Dombivli city published at an interval of every 10 seconds.

dataDescriptor.dataDescriptorLabel: Data Descriptor for Kalyan-Dombivli Realtime Bus Live tracking
dataDescriptor.description: Data attribute details for live vehicle position of the public transit buses in Kalyan-Dombivli city.

route_id.description: Route ID assigned to the route on which the bus corresponding to this observation is currently plying on.

license_plate.description: Vehicle registration number/license plate number of the bus corresponding to this observation.

actual_trip_start_time.description: This field denotes the time at which service actually began.

last_stop_arrival_time.description: This field specifies the actual arrival time at the previous stop along the route of the trip corresponding to this observation.

speed.description: The speed of the bus corresponding to this observation.

stopScheduleRelationship.description: The realtime status of the bus with respect to the stop corresponding to this observation. The value 'SCHEDULED' denotes that the stop is covered; the arrival time to the stop is available. The value 'NO_DATA' denotes that the stop is not covered yet or there in no realtime information from the device; the arrival time is not available/None.

start_date.description: Describes the initial scheduled start date of the trip corresponding to the vehicle this observation.

start_time.description: Describes the initial scheduled start time of the trip corresponding to the vehicle this observation.

trip_id.description: Unique ID allotted to the bus trip corresponding to this observation.

last_stop_id.description: Stop ID of the previous bus stop corresponding to the bus in this observation.

location.description: The coordinates for the current position of the bus corresponding to this observation.

observationDateTime.description: The time at which the bus was last tracked.

bearing.description: Indicates vehicle GPS angle measured in a clockwise direction from the True North.

vehicleID.description: Unique ID assigned to the vehicle corresponding to this observation.

direction_id.description: Indicates the direction of travel of the bus corresponding to this observation,

schedule_relationship.description: Describes the status of the trip corresponding to this observation.

It gives average values of air pollutant measures  like carbon monoxide, nitrogen dioxide, ozone, particulate matter etc., and also the associated environmental factors like temperature, humidity, illuminance over an time interval of 15 minutes. More details on the type of pollutant measured and units of measurement can be seen in the Data Descriptor.
